ucs.title: [LLM] Qilin (Agenda) GPO-pushed Chrome/Edge credential harvesting from domain controllers
ucs.description: Hunts the Qilin tradecraft Sophos publicly attributed in Aug-2024: after compromising a DC, Qilin operators push a PowerShell logon-script via Group Policy that sweeps every endpoint's Chrome 'Login Data', 'Local State' and DPAPI vault, then stages credentials in SYSVOL. Detects a script interpreter spawned from gpscript.exe (or executed out of \\SYSVOL\\...\\Policies\\{GUID}) that touches the Chromium credential store paths — a combination effectively unique to this actor.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.parent_process) as parent_cmd from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.parent_process_name="gpscript.exe" OR Processes.parent_process="*\\SYSVOL\\*" OR Processes.process="*\\SYSVOL\\*\\Policies\\{*") AND Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe") AND (Processes.process="*Login Data*" OR Processes.process="*Local State*" OR Processes.process="*\\Google\\Chrome\\User Data*" OR Processes.process="*\\Microsoft\\Edge\\User Data*" OR Processes.process="*vaultcli*" OR Processes.process="*Win32_ShadowCopy*" OR Processes.process="*DPAPI*") by host Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.parent_process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let GpoSpawned = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "gpscript.exe"
        or InitiatingProcessFolderPath has @"\SYSVOL\"
        or InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any (@"\SYSVOL\", @"\Policies\{")
    | where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe")
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("Login Data","Local State","Web Data",@"\Google\Chrome\User Data",@"\Microsoft\Edge\User Data","vaultcli","DPAPI","Win32_ShadowCopy")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"     // exclude machine accounts
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, AccountDomain,
              ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
              ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ChildImage  = FolderPath,
              ChildCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,
              SHA256;
GpoSpawned
| join kind=leftouter (
    DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FolderPath has_any (@"\Google\Chrome\User Data\",@"\Microsoft\Edge\User Data\")
    | where FileName in~ ("Login Data","Local State","Web Data","Cookies")
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccessedFile = FullPath = strcat(FolderPath, FileName)
) on DeviceName
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventID == 4688
| where (ParentProcessName endswith @"\gpscript.exe"
     or ParentProcessName has @"\SYSVOL\"
     or CommandLine has_any (@"\SYSVOL\", @"\Policies\{"))
| where NewProcessName has_any (@"\powershell.exe",@"\pwsh.exe",@"\cmd.exe",@"\wscript.exe",@"\cscript.exe",@"\mshta.exe")
| where CommandLine has_any ("Login Data","Local State","Web Data",@"\Google\Chrome\User Data",@"\Microsoft\Edge\User Data","vaultcli","DPAPI","Win32_ShadowCopy")
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"     // exclude machine accounts
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Account = SubjectUserName, SubjectDomainName,
          ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Qilin/Agenda GPO-Pushed Chromium Credential Harvest
id: 8c2c5a7e-9b41-4d11-9e3a-7f3a8a0b1c01
status: experimental
description: Detects PowerShell/cmd/wscript spawned from a Group Policy logon-script context (gpscript.exe or SYSVOL\Policies path) that accesses Chrome/Edge credential stores, vaultcli or DPAPI — the Sophos-attributed Qilin 2024 tradecraft.
references:
  - https://news.sophos.com/en-us/2024/08/22/qilin-ransomware-caught-stealing-credentials-stored-in-google-chrome/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/15
tags:
  - attack.credential_access
  - attack.t1555.003
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.persistence
  - attack.t1037.001
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  parent_gpo:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\gpscript.exe'
  parent_sysvol:
    ParentImage|contains:
      - '\SYSVOL\'
      - '\Policies\{'
  child_interpreter:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\mshta.exe'
  cred_targets:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'Login Data'
      - 'Local State'
      - 'Web Data'
      - '\Google\Chrome\User Data'
      - '\Microsoft\Edge\User Data'
      - 'vaultcli'
      - 'DPAPI'
      - 'Win32_ShadowCopy'
  condition: (parent_gpo or parent_sysvol) and child_interpreter and cred_targets
falsepositives:
  - Internal IT credential-audit tooling pushed via GPO (rare, allowlist by script hash)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 (@ParentImage:(*\\gpscript.exe OR *\\GPScript.exe OR *\\GPSCRIPT.EXE) OR @CommandLine:(*\\SYSVOL\\* OR *\\sysvol\\* OR *\\Policies\\{*)) @Image:(*\\powershell.exe OR *\\PowerShell.exe OR *\\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\\pwsh.exe OR *\\cmd.exe OR *\\CMD.EXE OR *\\wscript.exe OR *\\WScript.exe OR *\\cscript.exe OR *\\mshta.exe) @CommandLine:(*"Login Data"* OR *"Local State"* OR *"Web Data"* OR *"Google\\Chrome\\User Data"* OR *"Microsoft\\Edge\\User Data"* OR *vaultcli* OR *DPAPI* OR *Win32_ShadowCopy*) -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ParentBaseFileName=/gpscript\.exe$/i OR ParentImageFileName=/\\SYSVOL\\/i OR CommandLine=/\\SYSVOL\\|\\Policies\\\{/i
| ImageFileName=/\\(powershell|pwsh|cmd|wscript|cscript|mshta)\.exe$/i
| CommandLine=/Login Data|Local State|Web Data|\\Google\\Chrome\\User Data|\\Microsoft\\Edge\\User Data|vaultcli|DPAPI|Win32_ShadowCopy/i
| UserName!=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, ParentBaseFileName], function=collect([CommandLine]))
ucs.rationale: Pushing a credential-harvest script via GPO is a Qilin signature publicly burned by Sophos in 2024 — Conti/Black Basta/LockBit overwhelmingly opt for Mimikatz/lsass dump on the DC, not domain-wide Chromium credential vacuuming via SYSVOL logon scripts. The combined predicate (gpscript.exe/SYSVOL parentage + script interpreter + Chromium credential paths/DPAPI/vaultcli) is almost impossible to trig

ucs.title: [LLM] Qilin/Agenda safe-mode reboot to disable EDR + recovery sabotage chain
ucs.description: Hunts the Qilin/Agenda execution preamble: bcdedit configures Windows to boot into Safe Mode (minimal or network) so security agents that don't auto-start there are bypassed, followed within ~1h on the same host by recovery teardown (vssadmin/wmic shadow-copy delete, wbadmin catalog delete, bcdedit recoveryenabled=No) right before the encryptor runs. Both halves are in Qilin's documented MITRE technique list (T1562.009 + T1490) and the temporal pairing on a single host is essentially a Qilin/Agenda fingerprint.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime values(Processes.process) as cmds values(Processes.user) as users from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("bcdedit.exe","vssadmin.exe","wbadmin.exe","wmic.exe") AND (Processes.process="*safeboot*minimal*" OR Processes.process="*safeboot*network*" OR Processes.process="*delete*shadows*" OR Processes.process="*resize*shadowstorage*" OR Processes.process="*recoveryenabled*No*" OR Processes.process="*bootstatuspolicy*ignoreallfailures*" OR Processes.process="*shadowcopy*delete*" OR Processes.process="*catalog*-quiet*" OR Processes.process="*delete*catalog*") by host Processes.dest Processes.process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | eval is_safeboot=if(match(cmds, "(?i)safeboot.*(minimal|network)"),1,0) | eval is_sabotage=if(match(cmds, "(?i)(delete\s+shadows|resize\s+shadowstorage|recoveryenabled\s+No|bootstatuspolicy\s+ignoreallfailures|shadowcopy.*delete|delete\s+catalog)"),1,0) | stats min(firstTime) as first_seen, sum(is_safeboot) as safeboot_count, sum(is_sabotage) as sabotage_count, values(cmds) as observed_cmds, values(process_name) as procs by dest | where safeboot_count>0 AND sabotage_count>0 | sort - first_seen
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowMinutes = 60m;
let SafeBoot = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe"
    | where ProcessCommandLine has "safeboot"
         and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("minimal","network")
    | project SafeBootTime = Timestamp, DeviceName,
              SafeBootAccount = AccountName,
              SafeBootParent = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              SafeBootCmd = ProcessCommandLine;
let Sabotage = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where (FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("delete shadows","resize shadowstorage"))
        or (FileName =~ "wbadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("catalog","backup"))
        or (FileName =~ "wmic.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "shadowcopy" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete")
        or (FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("recoveryenabled no","bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures"))
    | project SabotageTime = Timestamp, DeviceName,
              SabotageAccount = AccountName,
              SabotageCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              SabotageProc = FileName;
SafeBoot
| join kind=inner Sabotage on DeviceName
| where SabotageTime between (SafeBootTime - WindowMinutes .. SafeBootTime + WindowMinutes)
| project SafeBootTime, SabotageTime,
          DelayMin = datetime_diff('minute', SabotageTime, SafeBootTime),
          DeviceName, SafeBootAccount, SafeBootParent, SafeBootCmd,
          SabotageProc, SabotageCmd
| order by SafeBootTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowMinutes = 60m;
let SafeBoot = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where NewProcessName endswith @"\bcdedit.exe"
    | where CommandLine has "safeboot" and CommandLine has_any ("minimal","network")
    | project SafeBootTime = TimeGenerated, Computer,
              SafeBootAccount = SubjectUserName,
              SafeBootCmd = CommandLine;
let Sabotage = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where (NewProcessName endswith @"\vssadmin.exe" and CommandLine has_any ("delete shadows","resize shadowstorage"))
        or (NewProcessName endswith @"\wbadmin.exe" and CommandLine has "delete" and CommandLine has_any ("catalog","backup"))
        or (NewProcessName endswith @"\wmic.exe" and CommandLine has "shadowcopy" and CommandLine has "delete")
        or (NewProcessName endswith @"\bcdedit.exe" and CommandLine has_any ("recoveryenabled no","bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures"))
    | project SabotageTime = TimeGenerated, Computer,
              SabotageCmd = CommandLine, SabotageProc = NewProcessName;
SafeBoot
| join kind=inner Sabotage on Computer
| where SabotageTime between (SafeBootTime - WindowMinutes .. SafeBootTime + WindowMinutes)
| project SafeBootTime, SabotageTime,
          DelayMin = datetime_diff('minute', SabotageTime, SafeBootTime),
          Computer, SafeBootAccount, SafeBootCmd, SabotageProc, SabotageCmd
| order by SafeBootTime desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Qilin/Agenda Ransomware Safe-Mode Boot + Recovery Sabotage
id: 4d1f2b0a-2c8e-4a55-9c41-aa1e3b8b2202
status: experimental
description: bcdedit reconfigures Windows to boot into Safe Mode (minimal/network) alongside a recovery-sabotage call — the Qilin/Agenda ransomware execution preamble used to bypass EDR agents that don't load in Safe Mode before encrypting.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1562/009/
  - https://www.trendmicro.com/en_us/research/22/h/new-golang-ransomware-agenda-customizes-attacks.html
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/15
tags:
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.t1562.009
  - attack.impact
  - attack.t1490
  - attack.t1489
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  bcdedit_safeboot:
    Image|endswith: '\bcdedit.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: 'safeboot'
  safeboot_modes:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'minimal'
      - 'network'
  condition: bcdedit_safeboot and safeboot_modes
falsepositives:
  - System administrator recovery / driver troubleshooting (rare on servers / endpoints in production)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @Image:(*\\bcdedit.exe OR *\\BCDEdit.exe OR *\\BCDEDIT.EXE) @CommandLine:(*safeboot* AND (*minimal* OR *network* OR *Minimal* OR *Network*))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\bcdedit\.exe$/i CommandLine=/safeboot\s+(minimal|network)/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName], function={ collect([CommandLine, ParentImageFileName]) | min(_time) })
| join({
    #event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
    | ImageFileName=/\\(vssadmin|wbadmin|wmic|bcdedit)\.exe$/i
    | CommandLine=/delete\s+shadows|resize\s+shadowstorage|shadowcopy.*delete|delete\s+catalog|recoveryenabled\s+no|bootstatuspolicy\s+ignoreallfailures/i
    | groupBy([aid], function=collect([CommandLine]))
}, field=aid, include=[CommandLine])
